Gauge.Name: F35 Spoiler Control
Gauge.Comment:
This gauge controls the FS-Spoiler for Dino's V3.01 and V2.41 F35 package (A,B,C). Works for FSX and P3D, and with or without TacPack installed.
What it does: By controlling the SpoilerHandle, it splits to FS-SPoiler range in two parts: max. 45 percent contribution for externally loaded weapons/tanks drag, and 55 percent for actual spoiler (airbrakes). Individual weapons in the internal bay don't contribute to drag; instead a fixed drag is used when the internal bay is open.
Notes: - In the .air files, the Spoiler drag coefficient needs to be raised, to get the same Spoiler (airbrakes) drag as before. Meaning that at SpoilerHandle 55 percent (airbrakes extended, no external loadout), drag is the same as previously. .. For V2.41: from 122 to 250. .. For V3.01: from 240 to 400. - In V2.41, the spoiler surfaces (rudder, flaps, slats) are visually modelled by directly using the FS-SPoiler extention value. Meaning that with no spoiler (airbrakes) deployed, and at max. weapons drag, the spoiler looks "a little" extended. In V3.01 of the F35 package this is solved.
In detail: The FS-Spoiler function is used to induce external weapons/tank drag, in the following way: - (A:SPOILERS HANDLE POSITION,percent) is set to 0.1 for value (L:F35TotalDrag,number) = 0 - (A:SPOILERS HANDLE POSITION,percent) is set to 45 for value (L:F35TotalDrag,number) = (L:F35TotalDragMax,number) or higher. - And lineairly in between. - The result of (A:SPOILERS HANDLE POSITION,percent) is increased by 0 (spoiler retracted) or 55 (spoiler extended). - For initialisation purposes and ToggleSpoiler tracking, the (A:SPOILERS HANDLE POSITION,percent) is forced to 0.1 at aircraft load.
The value of (L:F35TotalDrag,number) is calculated as the sum of estimated drag contribution per actual, external loaded tank/weapon. Which is estimated based on shape. The presence of a pylon only, or tank/weapon plus pylon, is detected by reading the actual weight of the loadout per Payload Station, as described in the F35 manual.
Type PossibleStations Weight/ID Dragnumber ==== ================ ========= ========== Internal bay doors - - 10 Pylon only 1,2,3,9,10,11 194 or 350 2 Sidewinder + pylon 1,11 382 1.5+1=2.5 Gunpod 6 550 6 External tank + pylon 3,9 731 7+1=8 GBU31 + pylon 2,3,9,10 2475 3+1=4 (F-35B: STA 3 and 9 only) GBU12 + pylon 2,3,9,10 960 2+1=3 GBU10 + pylon 2,3,9,10 2464 4+1=5 (F-35B: STA 3 and 9 only) JSOW + pylon 2,3,9,10 1391 5+1=6 MK84 + pylon 2,3,9,10 2389 5+1=6 (F-35B: STA 3 and 9 only) MK83 + pylon 2,3,9,10 1336 4+1=5 MK82 + pylon 2,3,9,10 908 3+1=4
Notes: - (A:PAYLOAD STATION WEIGHT:2,pounds) corresponds with STA 1, etc. - The value of an estimated Dragnumber by itself is arbitary; only the ratio is important. - With these Dragnumbers, the max. loadout drag (L:F35TotalDragMax,number), at which 45 percent Spoiler is set: 200 + 2*50 + 2*170 + 2*115 + 120 = 990 (i.e. 45 percent SpoilerHandle).
Speed indications, measured with V2.41 of the F-35B (at 1000 ft, 90 percent Throttle, ca. 50.000 lbs total weight). - No weapons drag, no spoiler: 570 Knots GS (0 percent SpoilerHandle). - Max. weapons drag, no spoiler: 450 knots IAS (45 percent SpoilerHamdle). - No Weapons drag, spoiler deployed: 410 Knots IAS (55 percent SpoilerHandle). - Max. weapons drag, spoiler extended: 330 knots GS (100 percent SpoilerHamdle).
V1.1: - Increased update freq. for Spoiler animation - Uses new Var (L:F35Spoiler,percent) for V3.01 and up (has no effect on the V2.41 visual models.)
V1.2: - changed description. - Added fixed drag for internal bays/doors. - changed ratio spoiler-weapons drag from 65-35 to 55-45. - changed some drag number (forgot to include the pylons) - added Payload Station Lvars, if/when used in the .mdls.
